queries: WITH type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM type_rates) SELECT tr.Name, tr.rate, tr.track_count, tr.rate - o.mean_rate AS rate_above_mean FROM type_rates AS tr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE tr.rate > o.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: Each MediaType row is one type, even if two rows share a name. A missing Bytes value or zero Milliseconds yields no ratio; AVG skips it.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat identical media type names as one type, combining their tracks before calculating rates and the mean.
